component.name: Log Viewer
Log Viewer 日志查看器
component.summary: Read, search and follow log files
阅读、搜索并实时跟随日志文件

description.p: Log Viewer presents text log files in a table: one entry per line with the timestamp, level, thread, source and message. Long messages are truncated in the table and shown completely in the details pane.

Find highlights matches without hiding rows; Filter hides rows that do not match the level, time range or keyword. Messages containing JSON, XML or YAML fragments are highlighted with the Visual Studio Code colour scheme. A single file can be followed live ("tail -f" style).
